questions.question: What happened to Jerusalem and the temple in this final chapter?
options: They were sold to a neighboring king
They were spared in return for a heavy tribute
They were rebuilt grander than before
They were destroyed and burned by Babylon
questions.answer: They were destroyed and burned by Babylon

questions.question: What happened to King Zedekiah of Judah?
options: He was captured, blinded, and taken to Babylon
He surrendered and was graciously spared by the king
He was killed defending the temple gate
He escaped by night and fled into Egypt
questions.answer: He was captured, blinded, and taken to Babylon

questions.question: The people of Judah were carried into exile in Babylon.
The Babylonians burned the _____ of the LORD and the king's palace.
King _____ of Judah was blinded and carried to Babylon.
